name: Casdoor
description: An open-source UI-first Identity and Access Management (IAM) / Single-Sign-On (SSO) platform with web UI supporting OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, TOTP, MFA, and more.

runmode = prod
SessionOn = true

driverName = postgres

showSql = false
redisEndpoint =
defaultStorageProvider =
isCloudIntranet = false
authState = "casdoor"
socks5Proxy = "127.0.0.1:10808"

initData = "./init_data.json"

isUsernameLowered = false
origin = "https://${{ inputs.mainDomain }}"
staticBaseUrl = "https://cdn.casbin.org"

batchSize = 100
enableGzip = true
ldapServerPort = 389
radiusServerPort = 1812
radiusSecret = "secret"
quota = {"organization": -1, "user": -1, "application": -1, "provider": -1}
logConfig = {"filename": "logs/casdoor.log", "maxdays":99999, "perm":"0770"}
initDataFile = "./init_data.json"
frontendBaseDir = "../web/build"
